what_this_is: "When this happens" rules and "at a time" schedules as two account-owned Workshop tools, so any screen, workflow, rule or AI that runs Workshop tools can set, list, remove and run them now. Both call src/automations.mjs, the same owner as the set_rule/set_schedule MCP tools and the Automations screen.

payload.label: When this happens, run a tool or workflow
payload.job: Set, list, remove or run now this person's rules: when something is recorded in their Trillion (a message, a decision, a commercial event such as a paid deal, any kind they keep), an item is added to a pursuit they are in, or an event arrives from outside, a tool runs or a workflow starts by itself
payload.description: The same rules as set_rule, list_rules, remove_rule and run_now. when: { recorded: <kind>, where: [{ field, equals | one_of | starts_with | contains | present }] } for a record, { space_id, kind, where } for a space item, or { source_id, event, words } for an outside event. A paid negotiated offer is recorded as kind commercial-event with event negotiated_offer_paid, contract_id and buyer_ref. Each rule runs once per thing that sets it off, only for what happens after it is set.

operation.description: set (also changes or turns on and off one with its id), list (when left out), remove, run-now (runs it once, now), or reset (puts one of Trillion's own back as Trillion has it now)

rule_id.description: A rule_id from list; set with it changes that rule, remove, run-now and reset need it

when.description: What sets it off: { recorded, where }, { space_id, kind, where } or { source_id, event, words, whole_word, field, once_per, skip, batch }

then.description: What runs: { "tool_id": "tool:...", "input": {...} } or { "workflow_id": "workflow:...", "input": {...} }. An input value { "fill": { "from": "record", "field": "text" } } is taken from what set it off.

label.description: What the rule is for, in plain words

input.description: run-now: values laid over the then's own input

provenance.source: src/automations.mjs automationToolActions, the owner the MCP tools in src/automation-tools.mjs and the /automations routes reach

screen.label: When this happens
screen.about: Run a tool or workflow by itself when something is recorded or arrives.

payload.label: At a time, run a tool or workflow
payload.job: Set, list, remove or run now this person's schedules: at one time, or every day or week at a local time in a time zone, a tool runs or a workflow starts by itself
payload.description: The same schedules as set_schedule, list_schedules, remove_schedule and run_now. every: { unit: day | week, at: "09:00", time_zone, on: [monday, ...], interval } repeats; once_at: "2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00" runs once. starts_on is the first day it may run. list shows each schedule's next run and last_run.

operation.description: set (also changes or turns on and off one with its id), list (when left out), remove, run-now (runs it once, now), or reset (puts one of Trillion's own back as Trillion has it now)

schedule_id.description: A schedule_id from list; set with it changes that schedule, remove, run-now and reset need it

every.description: { unit: day | week, at: 24-hour local time, time_zone, on: days of the week, interval }

starts_on.description: First day it may run, like 2026-10-01

overlap.description: allow (default) starts at each time; wait retains an unfinished prior run until it ends. Run now still starts a new run. An existing schedule keeps its setting when omitted.

label.description: What the schedule is for, in plain words
